non_claims: This adjudication is a static/structural review plus the cheap court probes that fit the section 6.1 memory floor; it is not a runtime safety proof.
A NOT ESTABLISHED verdict is not a finding of a new memory-safety defect. The four source repairs and their tests reproduced.
The 290/290, 0/0, 153/0 and 2309 figures are reproduced as measurements; they are not, by themselves, SAFE_COMPATIBLE evidence.
The b78 review's ACCEPT of the 65 sites is not reversed here; the finding is that the review's own open residual, identity transfers and the campaign's grade gap prevent the claim of SAFE_COMPATIBLE.
